WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.location,
    COUNT(*) as qualify_count
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.location
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(qualify_count) as total_qualifies,
    COUNT(*) as num_cities
  FROM city_counts
),
city_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.location,
    cc.qualify_count,
    CAST(cc.qualify_count AS REAL) / s.total_qualifies as share,
    1.0 / s.num_cities as avg_share
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT 
  location,
  qualify_count as count,
  share,
  share - avg_share as above_average
FROM city_stats
WHERE share > avg_share
ORDER BY location
